quantitative_evaluation.regime_scoring_status: manual descriptive label only; no frozen intraday classifier or minute series, so do not count a quantitative regime hit
quantitative_evaluation.breadth_scoring_status: Diagnostic only: snapshot/repo lacks frozen flat-band breadth rule; positive count dominance is unambiguous

classification_notes.direction: ±5bp neutral band, strictly greater than 5bp is up. Open +5.3566bp is barely up; retain threshold sensitivity.
classification_notes.range: (high-low)/previous_close*10000; daily low equals open. Daily OHLC rules out a 0.3% drop below open, but cannot establish VWAP or exact high time.
classification_notes.brier: Mean squared error across three classes; single-day score is not multi-day calibration.

market_view.note: Mild positive close after a volatile rebound and persistent semiconductor weakness matched. Breadth/OTC were stronger and TSMC support weaker than forecast.

open_hypothesis.note: Raw sign and ±5bp class up hit, but +45bp forecast versus +5.3566bp realized overestimated the gap by 39.6434bp; stated 0% to +0.9% range contained it.

intraday_hypothesis.note: Rally then fade supports a volatile range interpretation; however daily low equaled open, contradicting the proposed 0.3% below-open excursion. OTC was not weaker than TAIEX. Minute VWAP/30-minute conjunction unverified.

close_hypothesis.note: Forecast +30bp versus actual +30.1023bp: absolute error 0.1023bp/0.4804 points; Base outcome hit.

breadth_hypothesis.note: Official 684 up/286 down gives 70.52% non-flat advancers; OTC +0.85% outperformed TAIEX +0.30%, contrary to flat/OTC-lagging framing.

bull_script.note: Close stayed below +50bp; TSMC closed 2420 below 2440 and the index did not retain 47366.

base_script.note: Base close and financial support held, but TSMC did not support the close and there was no below-open retest.

bear_script.note: Index never traded below prior close and ended positive.

key_driver_evaluation.note: Night futures supported the positive sign, but direct gap magnitude was overstated.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: Dow +1.08%、S&P 500 +0.33%、Nasdaq +0.08%，但SOX -0.88%、TSM ADR -1.80%，大盤與半導體背離。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Semiconductor divergence persisted: semiconductor -0.32%, TSMC -0.82% while overall TAIEX gained.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 10/15 TAIEX收46,969.87、-3.41%，上市204漲/818跌、OTC -5.53%，具技術性修復空間但去槓桿風險仍在。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Post-selloff repair occurred with positive breadth; recovery extended beyond large caps and OTC beat TAIEX.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 台積電Q3淨利7,630.6億元、EPS 29.43元，Q4美元營收指引523至543億美元，基本面正向。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Positive TSMC fundamentals did not translate into a stock-price gain; TSMC closed 2420, down 20.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 美國10年期殖利率約5.087%，單日明顯回落；Brent約105.92美元，高利率與能源風險仍存。
key_driver_evaluation.note: Yield decline is plausible support, but causal contribution cannot be isolated.

key_driver_evaluation.driver: 新台幣10/15收32.265、重貶1.92角，外資與權值股承接仍受壓。
key_driver_evaluation.note: FX pressure remained observable in intraday CNA coverage, but does not establish a measured causal effect on closing returns.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 若現貨未開高，open_direction=up立即失效，但不得回寫本快照。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Open exceeded previous close, albeit by just +5.36bp.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 若開高後30分鐘跌破前收且OTC、AI權值與上市廣度同步轉弱，Base/Bull失效，Bear風險上升。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Daily low was above previous close; no below-prior-close trigger.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 若台積電守住2,440、指數站穩47,366且非平盤上漲家數占比超過60%，提高Bull/trend_up風險。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Broad stock advances exceeded 60% and price traded above 47366, but TSMC failed 2440 and index closed below 47366. Full conjunction not satisfied; minute timing unverified.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 08:50後資訊與09:00後現貨行情不得回寫，只能納入事後覆盤。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Original frozen prediction unchanged; subsequent prices only used in realization/evaluation.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.condition: 本檔不得宣稱為TEJ、ARIMA或TimesFM OHLC模型預測。
invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Legacy output remains separate from TEJ/ARIMA/TimesFM OHLC metrics.

error_attribution.data: No minute OHLC/VWAP/AI-basket minute series or TPEx breadth. Official stock breadth replaces news-universe counts. Prediction missed current cutoff/persistence deadlines.
error_attribution.inference: Expected a possible first-30-minute dip and OTC underperformance; official low=open and OTC +0.85% contradict those paths.
error_attribution.weight: TSMC support/large-cap concentration overweighted; financials, midcaps, PCB and other non-semiconductor sectors underweighted.
error_attribution.magnitude: Gap overestimated 39.64bp; close nearly exact at 0.10bp error.
error_attribution.regime: High volatility/rally-fade description partially right, but formal regime hit cannot be reproduced without frozen classifier and minute data.

actual_driver_attribution.evidence: Official financial +1.10%, ex-financial/electronics +1.13%, midcap100 +1.39%, Taiwan50 -0.02%, semiconductor -0.32%.
actual_driver_attribution.causal_status: Descriptive cross-sectional evidence, not exact index point attribution.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: PCB, shipping and selected technology supported recovery while TSMC stayed weak.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: CNA: PCB strong; shipping gains; TSMC 2420/-0.82%. TPEx +0.85% beat TAIEX.
actual_driver_attribution.causal_status: Dated observed associations; exact contributions unavailable.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: Initial rebound lost much of its peak advance.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: Official high 47520.60 vs close 47111.26, a 409.34-point fade; CNA confirms gains narrowed after mid-session.
actual_driver_attribution.causal_status: Observed price path, not proof of Friday-positioning causality.

source_conflicts.resolution: Use official OHLC plus MI_INDEX and CNA. StockQ labels stale number 13:22; FTV corrected its story at 14:40.
Use TWSE MI_INDEX stock column. News universe is not fully specified; do not mix counts.
Keep official broader total and CNA session figure separately; coverage/timestamps differ.

proposed_model_changes.proposal: Calibrate cash-open gap separately from futures premium when local futures and semiconductor ADR signals diverge.
Model breadth/OTC repair independently of TSMC; add financial, midcap and non-electronics rotation signals.
Require a frozen minute-based regime classifier and explicit breadth neutral band before counting diagnostic labels in aggregate accuracy.
Enforce 08:30 input cutoff and 08:40 persistence; retain original late legacy records without retroactive promotion.

model_change_gate.reason: One late legacy sample cannot establish a durable model improvement; hypotheses require eligible walk-forward evidence.

limitations: Late relative to new OHLC contract, despite pre-cash-open publication.
No new-model OHLC/TX forecast exists in this legacy snapshot, so eight-target OHLC errors cannot be computed.
Regime and breadth direction scores are diagnostic; no frozen full classifier.
Single-day Brier score is not calibration evidence.
Optional validation-skill shared reference resources were unavailable; explicit repo definitions, independent arithmetic and official data checks were used.
validation_assessment: Share with caveats: official date/OHLC/hash and arithmetic checked; minute-path and formal-model metrics remain unverified/ineligible.
